positive_snippets: Good stay for a family of six. Spacious open from both side. The pollution was an issue which was a general Gurgaon issue and not of the property. Thanks to Mehadi, Ankit, Subhash and Tejpal for providing a responsive service.
negative_snippets:
We had a disappointing stay overall. The property felt below average for the price. We booked mainly for the jacuzzi, but it was not maintained and never worked despite trying multiple times — even with staff assisting us.
The room also wasn’t in great condition: the bed was noisy and uncomfortable, and there was no running water in the washroom in the morning, which was very inconvenient.
The only positive was that the staff were quick to respond and genuinely tried to help, but unfortunately the facilities themselves were just not up to the mark.
Would not recommend for the price charged.

I had stayed at this property from 24th sep to 26th
I had a very disappointing experience at this hotel. The room was not clean upon arrival – the floors were dirty, the bathroom had grime buildup, and the linens looked questionable.

To make matters worse, the jacuzzi, which was one of the main reasons I booked this hotel, was not working at all. When we called reception they said someone will come but no one came and when went to the reception no one was around.

On top of that, the room and surrounding areas had a serious issue with flies and insects, making it very uncomfortable to relax or sleep. It’s clear that proper cleanliness and maintenance standards are not being upheld.

Unfortunately, I cannot recommend this place based on my experience. Definitely not worth the money, and I hope management takes steps to improve.

Also the photos which are posted on the website and actual room when you see it its a huge difference
